Gulshan Kumar and T-Series presents Bhushan Kumar's "DEVA". Sung by Sachet Tandon, and the music is composed & Penned by Manan Bhardwaj.
One of the most loved prayers to Lord Ganesha- We salute the Supreme Lord Ganesha of the curved trunk ( Vakratunda ). Vakratunda Mahakaya (vakratund mahakay).
Om Gan Ganpataye Namo Namaha.
